description: This PHP source file handles AJAX requests related to WiFi spectrum analysis, including functions for MAC address translation, rearranging spectral data, retrieving WiFi neighbor diagnostic results, and managing diagnostic enablement states.

methods.name: mac_translate
methods.description: Converts a MAC address to uppercase and formats it with colons if necessary.

methods.name: rearrange_SDTR
methods.description: Adds a newline character after the third comma in a comma-separated list, restructuring spectral data string.

methods.name: get_results
methods.description: Retrieves WiFi neighbor diagnostic results, formats BSSID MAC addresses, and returns diagnostic data or in-progress status.
